course.title: Coastal and Special Zones Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value:
Wave having a wave height of 3.0 m break on a quartz beach with median (13)   
grain size, D50 = 1.0 mm at a wave breaking angle α(b) = 4.5 degree. Assume   
a median grain size D50 corresponding to a density of 2650 kg/m3, K   
coefficient = 0.65 and k = 1.0 for this problem. Calculate the potential   
immersed-weight and volumetric longshore sand transport rates.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
